title: Re-point human gate security tests to the live revoke command and document the current approval policy scope
summary: Converted retired HumanGate tests in test_bff_b5_001_security_hardening.py to test the live HumanGateRevoke command and assert 410 ACTION_RETIRED for retired commands; documented the current governance approval policy scope and known revoke gaps in services/governance/contract.md without modifying production code.

live_guarantees_tested.target_mismatch: test_human_gate_item_id_params_must_match_target_id verifies that HumanGateRevoke with mismatched human_gate_item_id is rejected with 422 HUMAN_GATE_TARGET_MISMATCH
live_guarantees_tested.anti_self_approval: test_human_gate_revoke_forbids_requester_self_decision verifies that HumanGateRevoke requested by the item requester is rejected with 403 HUMAN_GATE_SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN
live_guarantees_tested.two_man_authorization: test_high_risk_human_gate_requires_two_man_and_records_evidence verifies that high-risk HumanGateRevoke rejects missing signature with 409 TWO_MAN_SIGNATURE_MISSING, rejects signatures bound to other commands with 409 TWO_MAN_SIGNATURE_BINDING_MISMATCH, and accepts signatures bound to HumanGateRevoke with 202 recording two_man_signature_id in audit precondition_evidence and params
live_guarantees_tested.downstream_execution: test_human_gate_revoke_fails_closed_after_downstream_execution verifies that HumanGateRevoke fails closed with 409 HUMAN_GATE_REVOKE_DOWNSTREAM_EXECUTED when the effect was already executed
live_guarantees_tested.action_catalog: test_human_gate_catalog_requires_two_man_evidence verifies that HumanGateRevoke is HIGH risk and requires two-man evidence, and that retired commands (HumanGateApprove, HumanGateReject, HumanGateRequestMoreEvidence, HumanGateExtendTtl) have no catalog entry

governance_policy_scope_documented.proposer_self_decision: Blocked only for the 5 listed action targets in approval_targets.py SUBJECT_FIELDS (rebalance_apply, capital_pool_activation, capital_binding_activation, persona_lifecycle_transition, evolution_execute)
governance_policy_scope_documented.multi_decider_requirement: Two distinct deciders required only for capital/rebalance action targets with risk_direction == increase
governance_policy_scope_documented.ttl_policy: expires_at is decider-supplied via DecideRequest body; generic governance does not enforce a TTL cap (only dev paper approvals are capped at 24h via paper_approval_scope.py)

known_revoke_gaps_documented.requester_field_mismatch: BFF command_adapters/preconditions.py reads _HUMAN_GATE_REQUESTER_FIELDS which lacks owner_user_id from governance records, causing proposer revoke of governance approvals to return 202 instead of 403
known_revoke_gaps_documented.endpoint_namespace_mismatch: BFF command_adapters/governance_adapter.py dispatches revoke to /api/governance/human-gates/{id}/revoke instead of canonical /api/governance/approvals/{id}/revoke
